description: This file defines the Api class within the OrangeHRM installer utility, used for managing API-related data, including permissions and module details. It is part of a data transfer object (DTO) layer.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing API details, including permissions and module identifiers within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Api object with name, description, api, module, allowed permissions, and specific permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an Api instance from an array of data, validating the permissions and setting properties.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API string associated with this Api object.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module string associated with this Api object.
